objective: Encourage savings for girl child's education and marriage.
description: Account can be opened for girl child below 10 years of age by parent/guardian. Interest rate: 8.2% per annum, compounded yearly. Deposits for 15 years; account matures after 21 years from opening. Partial withdrawal permitted after girl attains 18 years for education (up to 50% of balance). EEE tax status (Section 80C deduction, tax-free interest, tax-free maturity). Maximum 2 accounts per family (exception for twins). Account can be opened at post offices and designated banks.
interest_rate_note: Historical rates in document; current rate 8.2% p.a. Historical rates referenced: 7.6% mentioned as outdated example.
